name: NonprofitEspocrm
author: skdvlpr
description: Nonprofit EspoCRM — adaptation of EspoCRM for nonprofit organizations. Includes custom CRM entities (Members, Volunteers/Employees, Meal Count, Grants & Funding, Reporting), roles, navbar provisioning, and reporting exports. Bundles two UI themes: Safehouse Aurora and Safehouse Aurora Light (frosted glass). Full interface localizations: English (en_US), Italian (it_IT), Russian (ru_RU).
